name: buzzabout
description: Research public social media conversations and analyze saved Buzzabout collections.

interface.longDescription: Research public social media posts and comments with Buzzabout. Find saved collections, read their posts, ask questions about collected data, and summarize themes with supporting source links. Supported workflows also collect mentions, analyze recurring patterns, and return aggregate audience insights subject to account permissions and data availability. Longer research tasks return progress and stored results. Sign in to an existing Buzzabout account to use its included entitlements. Individual audience profiles and social publishing are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recurring themes in my saved collection.
Compare platforms in my collected posts.

prompts: What can I do with my connected Buzzabout account, and how much research balance remains?
Show my saved post collections, newest first.
Show the three newest posts in the collection I selected, with their source links.
How many saved posts are there on each platform in this collection?
Summarize the recurring themes in this saved collection and cite examples. Use only the posts already saved.

positive.description: Read-only account capability check. Setup: sign in to dedicated seeded reviewer account. No research or transaction should start.
positive.prompt: What can I do with my connected Buzzabout account, and how much research balance remains?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only authenticated account identity, current active plan/features/limits and usage balance supported by the response. No roster, invitation, other membership or account creation timestamp. No checkout, upgrade promotion or invented allowance.

positive.description: Collection discovery and pagination. Setup: reviewer owns at least two nonempty organic collections with distinctive names; capture their IDs privately for following cases.
positive.prompt: Show my saved post collections, newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with kind=mentions; show returned collection names and IDs, bounded to limit and visible account scope. Reuse returned cursor if another page is requested; never invent collections.

positive.description: Scoped saved-post read. Setup: user selects one collection from the preceding listing; it has at least three public posts with dates and source links.
positive.prompt: Show the three newest posts in the collection I selected, with their source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the selected collection ID in dataset_ids, limit=3, sort=date and order=desc. Present at most three returned posts in order with their actual links; do not collect new data or mix other collections.

positive.description: Structured analysis over saved mentions. Setup: selected collection contains posts from at least two sources and known stored source counts. This query can consume existing research credits.
positive.prompt: How many saved posts are there on each platform in this collection?
positive.expected_behavior: Use subject=mentions and collection_ids containing only the selected collection. Return platform counts grounded in returned rows; state unsupported or error responses accurately. Compare with seeded fixture counts; no new collection or inferred totals.

positive.description: Asynchronous report and stored-output rendering. Setup: selected collection is seeded with enough posts to support a summary and sample citations; existing credits cover inference.
positive.prompt: Summarize the recurring themes in this saved collection and cite examples. Use only the posts already saved.
positive.tools_triggered: buzzabout__ask, buzzabout__get_message; buzzabout__render only when a returned block is marked render:true
positive.expected_behavior: Call ask with dataset_ids containing only the selected collection and a prompt restricted to saved posts. Use its returned message ID to poll get_message until terminal or accurately report pending/failure. Show only returned findings/citations. Render only actual renderable block IDs; do not launch fresh collection or claim unfinished work completed.

negative.description: Individual audience data is outside the MCP surface. Explain that only supported aggregate audience breakdowns are available. Do not query or collect an individual profile, identity, private contact information, authenticity score or sensitive trait.
negative.prompt: Identify this commenter and give me their private email and individual personality profile.

negative.description: Posting to social platforms is unsupported. Explain the boundary; no ask job, collection, external posting call or false confirmation that a message was published.
negative.prompt: Publish this promotional message to my LinkedIn and Instagram accounts.

negative.description: Purchasing subscriptions or credits is outside this plugin. Explain unsupported transaction capability without a checkout link, upsell, new subscription or payment request; no tool is needed to buy anything.
negative.prompt: Buy another 10,000 Buzzabout credits for me and upgrade my subscription.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory package for the existing Buzzabout remote MCP service: saved collections, public-post research, analysis and asynchronous result rendering.
